recommended_primary_scorer: Historical failure-rate (simple rule); blended offers little Capture gain

cold_start.cold_start_rule: heuristic scores = 0 (ranked last among all 131); logistic uses median-filled history + 2020 practice flags

leakage.historical_PT_features: computed only from Year < prediction year (cum_fail_rate, hist_max_abs, slopes, etc.)
leakage.practice_flags_in_FEATURE_COLS: QA/SIL/CNAS/MV/bal_num/is_CRO taken from CURRENT lab-year row in build_feature_rows — for 2020 holdout these are 2020 questionnaire values (disclosed residual contemporaneous limitation for practice flags; historical PT summaries are leakage-safe)
leakage.n_rec_year: included in FEATURE_COLS (same-year record count) — potential weak leakage for logistic; heuristics (fail/max) do NOT use it
leakage.cold_start_scoring: labs with has_history==0 get heuristic scores filled to 0 (ranked last); logistic still scores them via current-year practice flags + zeroed history after median fill
leakage.event_definition: abs(New_Bias%)>15 any record in lab-year; not ISR
